On this page, I attempt to “pre-register” predictions by committing to making them publicly here. I assign each prediction a confidence level and a resolution date.^[Sometimes may be an approximate date.] As they resolve, I’ll come back and keep a scorecard. I don’t edit entries, so I’m committing to showcasing my failures as well as my successes, and you can verify things via the page’s [change history](https://github.com/zacharylhertz/zacharylhertz.github.io/commits/main/predictions/predictions.yaml).
